App icons

73 concepts: 61 Phosphor 2.1.1 (Bold = normal, Fill = selected) and 12 custom glyphs on the same grid and weight. Each half: Bold at 20 / 28 / 36 pt, then Fill at 20 / 28 / 36 pt, on the watercolour wash (role colour 16 %). Body and limitation icons are two-tone (LayeredIcon): figure in ink at 55 %, mark in sienna, on an ochre wash (24 %).
